title: Print elements
lede: 17 woodcut, linocut and engraving prints traced from the woodcuts mood board, 30 versions in all: fruit, oak and acorns, pinecones, flowers, a mountain range and a flock of swallows. Transparent SVG and PNG. They keep the colours they were printed in, because they are often used under a transparency.

elements.title: Flock of swallows, blue (original)
elements.desc: About eleven barn swallows rising in a loose diagonal flock, in fine 19th-century engraving line: hatched wings, stippled breasts, white throats. Our main motif. Fine line, so use it large.

elements.title: Flock of swallows, black
